summary: This note is a Wikipedia-style biography of Paul Jarrico, born Israel Shapiro in Los Angeles on January 12, 1915. It covers his immigrant, socialist family background, his involvement with the Young Communist League and the American Communist Party from 1937 to 1952 while at UCLA, and his marriage to Sylvia Gussin plus the family link to screenwriter Michael Wilson.
one_line: Biography of Paul Jarrico, a Los Angeles-born screenwriter's early life, Communist Party membership, and marriage ties.
key_facts: Paul Jarrico was born in Los Angeles, California on January 12, 1915, as Israel Shapiro.
Paul Jarrico's father was a Russian Jewish immigrant who was a lawyer, poet and socialist.
While attending UCLA, Paul Jarrico joined the Young Communist League.
Paul Jarrico became an active member of the American Communist Party.
Paul Jarrico's alliance and association with the American Communist Party lasted from 1937 to 1952.
Paul Jarrico married Sylvia Gussin in 1936.
Sylvia Gussin's younger sister, Zelma, married screenwriter Michael Wilson in 1941.
